Program/Service 1:
answer_as_filed: Outpatient healthcare services, including primary care, behavioral health counseling, psychiatry, dental care, and case management. Access to these services is further supported through patient service representatives, patient navigators, and referral representatives who help connect patients with the care and resources they need. In addition, 340B funds support charity care and sliding fee scale programs that reduce or eliminate out-of-pocket costs for eligible patients, as well as investments in electronic health record (EHR) systems that improve care coordination, quality, and patient access.

Program/Service 2:
answer_as_filed: Pharmacy services to support access to medications and improve patient health outcomes. Services include all pharmacy operational expenses necessary to dispense medications and provide patient care. Eligible patients may receive medications at reduced cost or no cost based on income and affordability. Additional services include free home delivery to improve medication access, as well as free compliance packaging to help patients manage complex medication regimens, improve adherence, and reduce medication-related errors.

Program/Service 3:
answer_as_filed: Administrative and operational services that support the delivery of patient care, including grant administration, medical records management, quality improvement and compliance activities, revenue cycle operations, and information technology (IT) services. These funds also help cover essential infrastructure expenses, such as occupancy costs for clinic locations, including rent, utilities, data services, telephone systems, and answering services.
